objectui#9502 repaired four sibling sentences that made the same "cannot be read" claim. ⛔ This one was left standing, on purpose, and PR objectui#9518 records that decision in `scripts/check-required-check-set.mjs`'s inventory docblock rather than leaving it undocumented.

## ⭐ Why it is not simply the fifth instance — the measurement

Its parenthetical names **two** things, and they do **not** have the same answer.

|:--|:--|:--|
| `required checks 清单` | ⭐ **YES** | `GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/rules/branches/main` → 200 with the nine contexts; `pnpm check:required-check-set` reads it on a schedule |
| `谁可绕过` (bypass actors) | ⛔ **NO** | see below |

**The bypass reading, taken by this seat 2026-09-14T17:0xZ:**

| call | result |
|:--|:--|
| `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rulesets/11776024` | **200**. Keys: `_links · conditions · created_at · current_user_can_bypass · enforcement · id · name · node_id · rules · source · source_type · target · updated_at`. ⛔ **No `bypass_actors` key.** |
| `GET /repos/objectstack-ai/objectui/rules/branches/main` | 5 entries; union of keys `parameters · ruleset_id · ruleset_source · ruleset_source_type · type`. ⛔ **No bypass key.** |
| **CONTROL** — same endpoint family, one argument changed: `GET /rulesets/99999999` | **404** ⇒ the endpoint discriminates, so a missing key is a reading and ⛔ not a reader that returns nothing for everything |

⇒ ⭐ **`current_user_can_bypass` answers *"can I"*, ⛔ never *"who can"*.** The bypass-actors roster is genuinely unreadable from this token.

## ⇒ The sentence is HALF TRUE, on precisely the leg it names FIRST

- **True** of `谁可绕过` — and that is the first item in its own parenthetical.
- **False** of `required checks 清单` — readable, and read on a schedule by a gate that lives in this repository.

⭐ **This is why it is a different card and not a rider.** Deleting it would erase a true claim; leaving it whole keeps a false one; and ⛔ ruling *"the bypass leg makes the whole sentence true"* was offered as an option and is **refuted above**. The repair is the same shape objectui#9502 used on its four siblings — **split the conjunction** — but the two halves here divide along a different axis (`read` vs `write` there; `which contexts` vs `which actors` here).

## What the repair looks like

Roughly: the bypass-actors half keeps its claim, and the required-checks half stops claiming unreadability and points at the instrument (`pnpm check:required-check-set` / `.github/workflows/required-check-set-patrol.yml`) instead of restating any membership. ⚠️ Per commandment #9 and objectui#9502's own ruling: ⛔ **do not write the nine context names into `AGENTS.md`** — that would recreate this card one edit later. Point at the gate; ⛔ do not copy its answer.

⛔ The closing sentence — 「上面几条写的都是实测到的可观测行为」 — is ⛔ not in scope and is not challenged here.
